decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall be incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 159 Jersey Road, Isleworth and shall be used for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities).

Condition : 5 - Before any work starts on site, details of a method of protecting the fruit tree in the centre of the rear garden during building works shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented as so approved before work commences and retained for the duration of work to build and fit the building out.  This shall include the use of exclusion fencing to an appropriate distance and measures to ensure that no plant, machinery or materials are placed within the area of the exclusion fencing and that the soil under the spread of the tree's branches is not compacted.Similar measures shall be put forward in respect of the evergreen tree on the eastern boundary immediately adjacent to the site of the proposed building works and, in the event that this is not practicable and has been demonstrated to be so by the applicant, a proposal for replacement planting of a similar semi-mature evergreen tree elsewhere on site shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and the details so approved shall be implemented as so approved within the first available planting season following the completion of the building.
description: Erection of a two storey detached outbuilding comprising basement and ground floor levels
